retained.name: Caribbean Crown Estate
retained.character: An expansive Saint Lucian sea-view estate arranged as a refined Caribbean pavilion compound: a grand central villa, a south garden salon, an east guest pavilion, and a secluded west guest retreat framing a long resort pool and sunset decks.
retained.summary: Caribbean Crown Estate is a dramatic, approximately $15-million-calibre tropical compound centered on a two-storey ivory main villa. Hip roofs, panoramic glazing, deep verandas, and upper balconies create a resort-like silhouette, while two low covered galleries link the principal social and east guest wings without compromising the pitched-roof composition. A detached west retreat offers privacy, and the north-facing 14-metre pool ensemble provides layered timber sun decks, dining space, and a clear Caribbean-view foreground.

retained.name: Caribbean Crown Estate
retained.character: An expansive Saint Lucian sea-view estate composed as a calm, ivory Caribbean compound: a two-storey central residence anchors the crest, with low pavilion wings framing an axial infinity-pool terrace toward the southern Caribbean horizon. Detached guest retreats sit discreetly in tropical planting, while a sculptural open garden lounge offers a sunset destination away from the main house.
retained.summary: Caribbean Crown Estate is conceived as a substantial but legible six-pavilion hilltop compound. The principal two-storey residence and its deep sea-facing veranda command the southern pool axis; low great-room and dining pavilions are linked by sheltered galleries, preserving a breezy resort-like rhythm beneath coordinated hipped roofs. Two detached guest retreats receive privacy within tropical gardens, while the northern arrival court creates a ceremonial approach. A long timber-decked pool terrace, framed by lounge decks and a separate curved sunset pavilion, makes the Caribbean view the estate’s defining outdoor room.

retained.name: Sea Crown Estate
retained.character: A grand Caribbean hilltop estate composed around an arrival court, palm gardens and commanding sea-facing terraces.
retained.summary: Sea Crown Estate is a Caribbean hilltop compound with a two-storey ivory main house, a sea-facing gallery wing, angled private guest retreats, an infinity-style pool terrace, open garden pavilion, fountain arrival court and palm-lined approach.
